scope: read-only source audit; deletion candidates are conditional, not executed replacements or visual/performance PASS

items.action: Use gpui_kit::application/init/open_window; remove direct Base initialization and manual Root construction.
items.conditions: Keep capture/profiler setup and one Root; verify overlay initialization and native/Web entry points.
items.status: Native gallery starts with gpui_kit::application() (examples/gallery.rs) and gallery::run calls gpui_kit::init and gpui_kit::open_window (examples/gallery/mod.rs); the WASM gallery enters through gpui_kit::platform::web_init/single_threaded_web (crates/gallery-web/src/lib.rs).

items.conditions: Retain full M3 roles, reference interpolation and token data; update theme only when it changes, preserving overlays and multi-window behavior.

items.conditions: Keep Symbols core acyclic when Material depends on it; preserve Kit integration and consumer capabilities.
items.status: Symbols d73f27c moved the Material browser into its own workspace member (browser/); the Symbols core package no longer depends on Material. Material pins Symbols 593aa15.

items.conditions: Kit still depends on unpatched gpui-pre 0.3.10. Inspect actual runtime source and repeat regressions; do not remove entire vendor trees based on package names.

items.action: Keep complete CPU scope and raw first-frame evidence; upstream FPS HUD is supplementary.
items.conditions: Upstream sampler excludes warmup/backlog and uses draw timing; it cannot prove whole-gallery <=2ms including first frame.

items.action: Keep dynamic browser reduced-motion integration.
items.conditions: No equivalent Story API was established in this audit; verify live preference changes before removal.

items.action: Replace manual input slot composition with Component Input prefix/suffix/appearance(false), retaining Material container styling.
items.conditions: Use the same InputState; validate internal padding, prefix/suffix spacing, focus and accessibility. Existing code does not duplicate IME/editing.
items.status: SearchField renders Component Input (Size and Sizable from gpui_kit::component) with Base InputState; Material owns only the bar container, icons and state layer.

items.action: Use Tag::custom for ordinary metadata/status labels, not count Badge.
items.conditions: Tag adds hover opacity(0.9) without an exposed hover override; precise static labels need a hook or a small renderer.

items.action: Use GroupBox/Settings for ordinary titled groups and field organization; remove redundant factories after call sites migrate.
items.conditions: Use content_style for body styling. Preserve connected corners, pair/details and Material-only surfaces; extra GroupBox nodes are not automatically faster.

items.action: Use Component Alert for appropriate urgent/danger messages.
items.conditions: Alert uses Role::Alert; do not silently upgrade informational Role::Status. Preserve action wrapping and reference appearance.

items.action: Reuse upstream queue, timeout, pause and dismissal when those are added; keep Material Snackbar as presentation.
items.conditions: Current Snackbar is caller-positioned surface, not a duplicated notification engine. Notification.content does not replace its shell or animation.

items.action: Reuse Component where its hooks meet the contract; retain Material renderers over Base parts for uncovered shape/ripple/track/thumb motion.
items.conditions: Component outer Styled does not expose every internal part. These current controls already reuse Base behavior; do not add extra wrappers merely to change imports.

items.action: Use Component Sheet for modal sheets; keep nonmodal standard sheet layout until a proper capability exists.
items.conditions: overlay(false) does not disable the Base focus trap; replacing a nonmodal side sheet would change keyboard access to main content.

items.action: Consolidate duplicated drag, double-click and window-control execution into Component TitleBar.
items.conditions: First provide caller labels/control slots, configurable height/traffic lights/leading geometry, overlay order and explicit close-veto adaptation; current private controls are not equivalent.

items.action: Reuse Settings organization and real RadioGroup semantics for radio choices; keep only Material connected layout.
items.conditions: ListItem selected/on_click is not a substitute for complete button/radio keyboard and accessibility behavior.

items.action: Keep Material linear/circular progress and spinner renderers; reuse Base Progress semantics (gpui_base::Progress value/indeterminate/accessibility_label) where they meet the contract.
items.conditions: Component Progress paints one bar color with its track at opacity(0.2), Size-derived 4-10px pill heights and a fixed 1s ease_in_out single-segment sweep (static 32.5% insets under reduced motion); M3 needs a secondary-container track, a 4px indicator/track gap, an end stop dot and the reference sweep timing. ProgressCircle strokes min(15% of width, 5px), sizes from Size (size_2..size_5) and animates a 1s ease_in_out arc; the reference circular frames, stroke geometry and caller-owned playback that survives virtual unmounting are not available. Spinner rotates a Lucide Loader icon at 0.8s with no external playback handle; Material uses Material Symbols and RepeatAnimationPlayback.

items.action: Keep MaterialDivider; Separator is not a styling adapter target for it.
items.conditions: Separator draws a fixed 1px absolute line (solid or 4/2 dashed) in theme.border with an optional centred text label; it has no full-width/inset/middle-inset variants, logical start/end insets with RTL direction, list/card context margins, configurable thickness or ColorRole (OUTLINE_VARIANT) binding that the pinned md3.io divider fixture requires.

items.action: Use FocusableExt::focus_ring to suppress Component rings on wrapped Kit controls; keep FocusRing for composed controls whose focus handle is internal.
items.conditions: ThemeStyled::focus_ring_style is crate-private styling applied by a control from its own focus state: a 3px theme.ring band at 0.5 alpha outside the border (or a 1px line when Theme::focus_ring is off). It cannot observe a descendant's focus. FocusRing tracks a non-tab-stop container and resolves contains_focused after commit, painting a Material ColorRole::INK outline; FocusableExt only toggles a control's own ring.

items.action: Keep the vendored gpui-fast 0.1.12 (default backend) with the gpui-pre compatibility patches carried forward; see its MATERIAL-MIGRATION.json.
items.conditions: Preserves raw touch observers and extended hitboxes through retained/scroll replay, full CPU profiler scopes and repeat playback. Kit selects unpatched crates.io gpui-fast; remove only after each patch has an upstream equivalent and the regressions pass. Frame observation in this crate sits behind the dev-only frame-observation feature; crates/consumer-check builds it off.

items.action: Keep the merged text system, OpenType and Metal presentation patches; see its MATERIAL-MIGRATION.json.
items.conditions: draw_with_status reports real command-buffer submission and drains autoreleased Metal objects per draw. Required for frame-submission evidence; verify against the published crate before removal. Frame observation in this crate sits behind the dev-only frame-observation feature; crates/consumer-check builds it off.

items.action: Dev-only overlay; a consumer does not patch this. Keep the submission counting merged from gpui-pre-web; see its MATERIAL-MIGRATION.json. The canvas-size patch is gone: upstream's sizing is correct at real device scale factors.
items.conditions: Backing-store sizing at real device scale factors is validated by scripts/check-gallery-dpr.py; repeat that check after any web backend update.

items.action: Dev-only overlay; a consumer does not patch this. Keep presentation-synchronization control, the weak-owner demand waker and renderer-outcome submission counting; see MATERIAL-PATCHES.md and SOURCE.json.
items.conditions: The >=500 FPS scroll gate counts only successful newly drawn submissions with vertical sync disabled; the published crate cannot report or disable this. Does not guarantee a target FPS.

items.action: Dev-only overlay; a consumer does not patch this. Keep the same presentation patches for the upstream comparison backend (--no-default-features); see MATERIAL-PATCHES.md and SOURCE.json.

review_scope: Three independent source audits cover components; facade/theme/icons/gallery; runtime patches/motion/performance. No runtime migration or deletion was executed in this audit. Entries added at implementation_commit (components newer than the original audit, vendor-gpui-kit) come from one source read of the imports and the public Component builders and have not been independently reviewed.
